_comment: Canned turns replayed by arena.llm.mockserver so rag runs offline. Scenario is chosen by the first case-insensitive substring of the first user message that matches `match`. Turn N is served after N assistant messages already exist. Single-hop scenarios are one search then the answer; multi-hop scenarios are two searches then the answer (the second query is built from what the first result revealed); unanswerable scenarios search once and then refuse without naming the real-world answer.

turns.content: According to the corpus, the CN Tower stands 553 metres tall.
The Space Needle was built for the World Fair held in 1962.
The Challenger Deep lies roughly 10935 metres below sea level.
The Amazon River is about 6400 kilometres long.
The Leaning Tower of Pisa is about 57 metres tall on its high side.
Excluding its pedestal, the Christ the Redeemer statue is 30 metres tall.
The Gateway Arch stands 192 metres tall.
The Sydney Opera House was formally opened in 1973.
Tokyo Tower was inspired by the Eiffel Tower, which stands 330 metres tall including its antennas.
The title passed to the Burj Khalifa, which opened in 2010.
The Empire State Building overtook it, and it is 443 metres tall to the tip of its antenna.
The corpus describes the Eiffel Tower but does not mention Gustave Eiffel's year of birth, so I cannot answer that from the available sources.
The corpus passage on the Statue of Liberty does not name its sculptor, so I cannot say who designed it.
The corpus gives the bridge's opening year but does not state when construction began, so I cannot answer that.
